decisions.reason: It is an incremental, low-cost glazed variant of the established industrial sectional door line, and with no clear negative performance signal the option value of keeping it outweighs the carrying cost.
The glazed insulated version addresses energy-efficient demand and remains an unresolved but low-cost option, so it is worth carrying while uncertainty persists.
Its dedicated website page signals a stronger commitment to this variant, and absent evidence of failure the option has not resolved against it.
